decisions.reason: Reusing a common website format does not change the requirement that each location uses a separate Wix website and account.
The shared format and location-specific branding policy does not change how visitors select a location or where they are routed.
The candidate already has a same-message scope modification applying the referenced design across master and location sites; no additional value or scope change is required.
The same-message introduction already records that packages and prices remain unchanged across reused location-site formats.
Reusing the website format for location sites does not alter the master site's role of consolidating brand, location, and informational content.

Allowing branding and wording to vary when reusing the format does not necessarily change the established SMASH ROOM brand name; the template Requirement already owns the location-specific customization rule.
The template reuse decision does not change the existing goal of minimizing SEO damage during the Bay Area branding and website migration.
A shared site format does not change the separate Wix accounts, payment setups, or payout isolation required for each location.
The source decision concerns reuse of presentation format and preservation of packages and prices, not the Wix booking platform or its scope.
Reusing a common website format does not change the requirement to isolate bookings, calendars, revenue, sales, and reporting by location.
